THE ATLAS JOURNAL / FIELD NOTES

A useful interface gives each decision room to breathe. Start with the information someone needs, put related things together, and make the next action clear.

Visual character comes from consistent choices: a typeface, a rhythm, a palette, and a few details that belong to the subject. The effect should support the content as well as catch the eye.

This is original sample editorial content for the Newsprint study.
